title: MLBB: Heroes Will Rise
description: The official music video for MLBB MSC 2024, bringing the spirit of competition into a world of heroes.
overview: Heroes Will Rise moves between live action and animated worlds to celebrate MLBB MSC 2024. Character moments, fantasy action and tournament imagery connect the journey of a player to the scale of the competition.

The production combines characters and animation created in Blender with shots rendered in Blender Cycles and Unreal Engine 5. These selected frames follow the shift from a dark, weightless space into a bright hero world and the final tournament stage. The linked production article includes the film and full crew credits.
